operacion.texto: Press the footpad on the ground so the drill stays steady.
operacion.cita: The deploy stage controls the position of a footpad, which is first preloaded against the surface to provide stability during drilling.

operacion.texto: Cut one bite, about 10 cm, then pull the drill back up.
operacion.cita: After drilling ∼10 cm into the subsurface, the drill is retracted, and the cuttings are deposited onto the surface using a rotary brush guided by a chute.

operacion.texto: Hammer only when the ground is hard.
operacion.cita: Percussion is normally initiated when drilling into hard material to reduce auger torque and prevent binding in the hole

operacion.texto: A brush sweeps the cuttings onto the surface in a small cone; the NIRVSS and MSOLO instruments read it.
operacion.cita: Once on the surface, the cuttings are analyzed by the NIRVSS and MSOLO instruments

operacion.texto: Go back down the hole and cut the next 10 cm, bite after bite.
operacion.cita: the drill is lowered back into the hole to cut another 10 cm bite (i.e., from 10 to 20 cm depth) and present new subsurface material for analysis.

operacion.texto: If the ground grabs the drill, take smaller bites.
operacion.cita: reducing the "drill bite" size from the nominal 10 cm to 2 cm per bite

operacion.texto: People watch the telemetry and change the plan almost live.
operacion.cita: human operators monitor drill telemetry and make operations modifications in near real time.

mide.texto: Ground temperature at each depth, with a sensor in the bit.
mide.cita: Passive bit temperature curves will provide a measurement of the subsurface thermal gradient by taking temperature measurements at various depths

mide.texto: How hard the ground is, from the energy and speed of drilling.
mide.cita: SDE and ROP computed from flight telemetry will allow for approximating the strength of subsurface (over)consolidated, icy regolith and ground ice material in situ.

mide.texto: A heater in the auger frees it if ice grips it.
mide.cita: The heater can also be used in cases of ice adherence (freezing in) and to enhance the sublimation of ice from the cuttings pile.
